name: clang-uml
description: An open-source reverse-engineering tool that generates class, sequence, package, and other diagrams from C and C++ code in PlantUML, Mermaid, or JSON form.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: C/C++逆向生成UML类图、序列图、包图等，以PlantUML、Mermaid和JSON格式呈现。
classificationNotes: Reverse engineering means converting C/C++ AST data into PlantUML, Mermaid, or JSON diagrams.
